title: SyzenHub  It has all the features you need
features:
SyzenHub | FPS Flick v1

SyzenHub is an advanced FPS Flick script packed with useful features, visual improvements, combat assists, and fun customisation options to improve your gameplay experience.

Character Features

- Change WalkSpeed
- No Velocity
- Bunny Hop
- X-Ray Vision
- Adjustable X-Ray Transparency
- Auto Respawn
- Quick Lobby / Play buttons

Visual Features

ESP

- Player ESP
- Highlight / Outline ESP
- Tracers
- Skeleton ESP
- Shows player distance and weapon
- Shield detection support

ESP Customisation

- Rainbow ESP effects
- Custom ESP colours
- Custom outline colours
- Adjustable outline transparency
- Adjustable ESP size
- Tracer position changer
- Adjustable rainbow speed

Game Visuals

- Custom Field Of View
- Full Bright
- No Fog
- FPS Unlocker
- Adjustable FPS cap

Aimlock Features

- Smooth Aimlock
- Nearest Player Lock
- Nearest Mouse Lock
- Auto Fire
- FOV Circle
- Rainbow FOV
- Wall Check
- Ignore Lobby Players
- Ignore Shielded Players
- Aim Part Selection
- Player Priority System
- Ignore Player System
- Adjustable smoothness and lock distances
- Custom aim offsets

Combat Features

- Auto Fire System
- Smart target detection
- Auto switch to knife when enemies are close
- Adjustable knife range
- Knife range visualiser

Crate Features

- Mass Open Knife Crates
- Mass Open Gun Crates
- Adjustable crate amount

Fun Features

RGB Features

- RGB Gun & Knife
- RGB Highlight Mode
- Neon Material Effects
- RGB Async Effects
- Adjustable RGB speed
- Multiple RGB spectrum modes

Sound Features

- Custom Hit SFX
- Custom Critical SFX
- Auto Apply SFX

Extra Features

- Real-time FPS Counter
- Real-time Ping Counter
- Real-time Health Counter
- Auto Config Save
- Smooth animations
- Mobile support with haptic feedback

Made to give a smoother and more enjoyable FPS Flick experience with lots of customisation and useful features.
